name: MEA Activation Ablation v1
question: Does target-specific projected margin-gradient control outperform iterative activation-aligned causal-subspace control under matched intervention budgets?

activation_control.direction_semantics: positive activation-aligned direction for upward control
activation_control.step_norms: exactly match the realized MEA step_norm sequence for the same sample
activation_control.maximum_steps: same number of realized MEA steps for the same sample

interpretation.tests: value of target-specific projected margin-gradient geometry beyond generic activation-aligned iterative causal control
